facts.text: The repository controls and operates Harvard Apparatus OEM model syringe pumps from a desktop program
The program is set up to control up to 3 pumps, each with its own address 00, 01 or 02
The program uses pyserial 3.5 and PyQt5 5.9.7, and its serial port defaults to COM1
Pumps is a QMainWindow desktop GUI class, not a device transport
The module's only runtime entry creates a QApplication, instantiates Pumps and enters the Qt event loop
Every command opens the serial line at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and a 0.5 s timeout
A diameter command is the bytes 'MMD ', the entered text and a carriage return
Flow-rate commands are 'MLH ', 'ULH ' or 'ULM ' followed by the entered text and a carriage return
The first pump group sends the unprefixed RUN and STP commands
The second pump group prefixes the same commands with 01: 01MLH, 01MMD, 01RUN and 01STP
The third pump group prefixes the same commands with 02: 02MLH, 02MMD, 02RUN and 02STP
The stop-all handler writes STP, 01STP and 02STP
The close handler writes STP, 01STP and 02STP to stop all pumps before exit
The diameter handler writes the command and closes the port without reading a reply
The GUI lists the diameters 4.78, 8.66, 12.06, 14.5, 19.13 and 21.7 mm for 1, 3, 5, 10, 20 and 30 mL syringes
The third pump's uL/min handler writes 02ULH instead of 02ULM
